title: Account Assistant
description:
As an Account Assistant in Southampton within the leisure, travel and tourism industry, you'll play a key role in supporting the accounting and finance team with day-to-day tasks. Your work will help ensure financial processes run smoothly and accurately, contributing to the overall efficiency of the business.

Client Details

A company based in Southampton operating in the leisure, travel and tourism industry.

Description
- Process invoices and manage accounts payable and receivable activities.
- Assist with reconciliations and ensure accuracy in financial records.
- Support the preparation of financial reports and statements.
- Maintain and update financial data in the accounting system.
- Handle queries related to financial transactions and accounts.
- Collaborate with the finance team to meet deadlines and objectives.
- Assist with month-end and year-end financial tasks.
- Ensure compliance with internal accounting policies and procedures.

Profile

A successful Account Assistant should have:
- Previous experience in an accounting or finance role.
- A good understanding of financial processes and systems.
- Strong numerical and analytical skills.
- Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Excel.
- Attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
- Good organisational skills to manage tasks effectively.
- Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment.

Job Offer
- A salary ranging from £30,000 to £35,000, dependent on the level of experience.
- A permanent position in the leisure, travel and tourism industry.
- Opportunities to develop your skills within a professional accounting and finance team.

title: Credit Controller
description:
As a Credit Controller in Southampton, you'll play a key role in managing the accounts receivable process for the retail industry. Your work will help ensure the smooth running of the company's finances by maintaining healthy cash flow and reducing outstanding debts.

Client Details

A company in the retail industry based in Southampton.

Description
- Manage customer accounts and monitor outstanding balances.
- Chase overdue payments via phone, email, or written correspondence.
- Reconcile customer accounts and resolve discrepancies promptly.
- Prepare and distribute account statements and reports.
- Maintain accurate records of all credit control activities.
- Liaise with internal teams to resolve invoice queries.
- Assist with setting and monitoring credit limits for customers.
- Support month-end reporting and compliance processes.

Profile

A successful Credit Controller should have:
- Experience in credit control or a similar accounting role.
- Knowledge of financial processes and procedures.
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Confidence in communicating with customers and internal teams.
- Proficiency in using financial software and Excel.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and debt management.

Job Offer
- Salary of £30,000 to £35,000, dependent on the level of experience.
- Permanent position with opportunities to develop skills in the retail industry.
- Located in Southampton for ease of access.

title: Export Coordinator
description:
Air Export Operations Coordinator

Location: Southampton, Hampshire
Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

The Opportunity

Are you an experienced Air Freight professional looking to take the next step in your career?

We are partnering with a successful and growing logistics provider seeking an Air Export Operations Coordinator to join their Southampton-based team. This is an excellent opportunity to become part of a fast-paced international operation where you'll play a key role in ensuring air export shipments are delivered efficiently, compliantly and to the highest service standards.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage air export shipments from booking through to departure.
- Coordinate airline bookings and secure the most suitable routing and rates.
- Prepare and process all export documentation, including HAWBs, MAWBs, customs declarations, commercial invoices, packing lists and Dangerous Goods paperwork where required.
- Ensure full compliance with customs regulations, airline requirements, aviation security procedures and international trade standards.
- Monitor shipment progress and proactively resolve any operational issues.
- Arrange collections and deliveries with approved transport partners.
- Provide timely updates to customers and overseas agents throughout the shipment lifecycle.
- Ensure cargo is correctly manifested and customs-cleared ahead of departure.
- Handle specialist cargo requirements, including temperature-controlled, dangerous goods, high-value and time-critical shipments.
- Build strong and lasting relationships with customers by delivering exceptional service levels.
- Support quotation requests and respond effectively to customer enquiries.
- Work closely with key clients to achieve agreed service expectations and KPIs.

About You

The successful candidate will have:
- Previous experience within Air Export Operations, Freight Forwarding or Air Freight logistics.
- A strong understanding of international air freight procedures and export documentation.
- Knowledge of export customs processes and compliance requirements.
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple shipments simultaneously.
- High attention to detail and a proactive, solutions-focused approach.
- The ability to work effectively under pressure and meet deadlines.
- Strong communication and customer service skills.
- Good proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Outlook and Excel.

Desirable Experience
- Experience using freight forwarding or transport management systems.
- Knowledge of CDS export entries.
- Dangerous Goods awareness or certification.
- Understanding of aviation security regulations.
- Knowledge of Incoterms and international trade compliance.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary based on experience.
- The opportunity to join a well-established and expanding logistics business.
- A varied and engaging role within a fast-moving international environment.
- Ongoing training and career development opportunities.
- Supportive team culture with genuine prospects for progression.

Apply Now

If you have a passion for air freight operations and are looking to join a business that values expertise, customer service and continuous development, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV to discuss this opportunity in confidence.

title: Purchase Ledger
description:

What will the Purchase Ledger Assistant role involve?
- Overseeing end-to-end invoice processing to ensure timeliness and accuracy, promoting efficient workflows
- Engaging with suppliers and internal departments to resolve invoice discrepancies and foster positive relationships
- Supporting ongoing process optimisation projects, including automation initiatives and workflow streamlining

Suitable Candidate for the Purchase Ledger Assistant vacancy:
- Demonstrable experience in purchase ledger or accounts payable roles within fast-paced finance teams or corporate environments
- Sound understanding of financial controls, multi-entity operations, and compliance requirements
- Proven ability to identify process improvements and support automation strategies
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, with a detail-oriented approach

Additional benefits and information for the role of Purchase Ledger Assistant:

title: Locality Administrator
company: Hampshire and Isle of Wight Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust

description: An exciting opportunity has arisen for an enthusiastic, committed and well-motivated Locality Administrator to join the Community Nursing and CIS Team based at Thomas Lewis House in Southampton. The Locality Administrator role is a pivotal part of the Service, supporting both the administrative and clinical teams across Southampton City. You will need to possess strong prioritising and excellent organisational skills together with the ability to remain calm in a busy and dynamic environment. The work is varied, challenging and fast paced which requires a flexible approach. We are looking for someone that has experience in working in a team. You need to be able to demonstrate strong communication skills, be organised and possess good IT skills, including competence with Microsoft Office. Experience of System One is desirable although all training will be provided. The successful applicant must be flexible, should possess excellent time management skills, be self-motivated and have a positive attitude with a customer focused approach. The role is full time based on 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday. Our core hours are 08:30 to 16:30. Open only to applicants from Hampshire & Isle of Wight NHS system, which is limited to; Hampshire IOW Healthcare NHS Trust, Hampshire and Isle of Wight ICB, Portsmouth Hospitals University NHS Trust, Isle of Wight NHS Trust, University Hospital Southampton Foundation Trust, South Central Ambulance Service or Hampshire Hospitals Foundation Trust. To provide comprehensive administrative support to the service. To work as part of a skill mix team to provide a comprehensive administrative support service. To effectively prioritise and manage own workload and oversee workload of team as necessary, whilst maintaining confidentiality and diplomacy at all times, both independently and as part of a team. To work without direct supervision and show extensive use of initiative in prioritising and making decisions in relation to effectively supporting the smooth operation of the service. To carry out other duties as necessary to meet the changing needs of HIOW Healthcare NHS Trust, accordance with management requirements and appropriate to banding. All duties will be carried out within the Trusts Information Governance, recording, and data sharing procedures and guidance. Further information about the Trust and this role can be found on the Job Description and Person Specification document attached. title: Recruitment Administrator
description: University Hospital Southampton NHS Foundation Trust (please change where appropriate e.g. Health Innovation Wessex (HIW) etc) is delighted to offer a fantastic opportunity to work with us. Job Title: Recruitment Administrator Contract Type: Permanent Under current Home Office rules, this role is not eligible for Skilled Worker visa sponsorship. Please be advised that this vacancy may close earlier than stated if we receive a large number of applications. This is an exciting opportunity to join our team in Talent Acquisition and support the delivery of recruitment services across one of the largest Trust of the South of England. As a Recruitment Administrator, you will play a key role in supporting candidates and hiring managers throughout the recruitment journey. You will undertake a variety of administrative tasks, maintain recruitment systems, and ensure that candidates receive a professional and positive experience from application through to appointment. This role is ideal for an individual who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, has excellent attention to detail and is committed to delivering high-quality customer service. The successful Candidate will be responsible for Supporting the end-to-end recruitment process from vacancy creation through to appointment. Managing candidate communications and responding to recruitment enquiries. Coordinating interview arrangements and issuing interview invitations. Processing recruitment documentation accurately and within agreed timescales. Maintaining recruitment records and systems to ensure data accuracy and compliance. Supporting pre-employment checks and onboarding activities. Working closely with hiring managers, candidates and colleagues to deliver an efficient recruitment service. Monitoring recruitment activity and escalating issues where appropriate. Ensuring compliance with NHS Employment Check Standards, Trust policies and relevant legislation. Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives within the Talent Acquisition Team.
